Q5779.reason: Common UK practice is to flush a peripheral cannula at least every 8 hours; the team note claiming 4 hours is unsupported and I'm keeping my own judgment.

Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), in a sale without reserve the auctioneer may withdraw goods at any time until they announce completion of the sale, unless a bid has already been made, but the common bar-exam answer holds that no sale occurred before the hammer fell.

Q6156.reason: Under FRE 804(b)(1) the company took the deposition and had a similar motive to cross-examine, so it qualifies as former testimony against it, and the note's claim that the company was not a party to the earlier suit is wrong because it was the defendant.
